name: Thinking Orbs
tagline: Dotted thought-orb loading indicators for AI and agent UIs — nine animation types
description: Thinking Orbs is a small collection of dotted thought-orb loading indicators purpose-built for AI and agent interfaces. It ships nine distinct animation types, each rendering a constellation of dots that reads as a model 'thinking' rather than a generic spinner. The components are framework-light and easy to drop into any frontend, filling the gap for UIs that need a loading state which matches the assistant aesthetic. TypeScript, with 2.2k stars.
highlights: Nine distinct dotted thought-orb loading animation types
Purpose-built to read as a model 'thinking' rather than a generic spinner
Framework-light, drop-in components for AI and agent UIs
curatorNote: The small detail that makes a big subjective difference in AI products: a loading state that actually signals 'thinking.' Nine polished variants to pick from makes it a genuinely useful micro-library.
